facts.title: How to Make Aguas Frescas
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pure cane sugar or agave nectar or sweetener of choice
Optional: 2 large mint leaves (perfect with cucumber)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In your blender container, combine the fruit, water, lime juice, sweetener and optional mint leaves. Purée until smooth using the smoothie feature. Taste and, if necessary, add more lime and/or sweetener, then blend briefly again.

facts.summary: These agua frescas are incredibly refreshing, unfiltered fruit juices that are perfect for summertime.

ingredient_groups.title: Ingredients per serving, multiply as necessary
